description.value: PokeLani is a Hawaiian poke restaurant on Main Street in North Vancouver where customers build customizable bowls from a selection of proteins (tuna, salmon, shrimp, chicken, tofu), bases (white rice, brown rice, noodles, spring mix, kale), and an array of fresh vegetables, sauces, and toppings. The fast-casual format is well-suited to hungry cyclists looking for a fresh, filling meal assembled quickly to order. Online ordering and delivery are also available for those who want to plan ahead.

address.value: 1331 Main St, North Vancouver, BC V7J 3J7

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 23m; rack (3 spaces) at 94m. Total: 11 spaces.
